title: M0: Feasibility and architecture
description: Resolve iPhone transport, Elecraft interfaces, transmit safety, feasibility architecture, and the v0 control contract.

title: M1: End-to-end bench proof
description: Demonstrate bidirectional audio, CAT, and fail-safe PTT from iPhone through a bench prototype to KX2, then validate KX3.

title: M2: Rev A reference hardware
description: Design, assemble, validate, and publish the first complete open-hardware reference package.

title: M3: Developer preview
description: Stabilize the protocol and Swift package, add update tooling, and publish a documented developer preview.
